title: How many guns the Chinese had round the town
reading: Four batteries south of the canal and the station, from 25 March
basis: The places the Japanese gave for the guns they saw or heard: Zhaishan, Hanshan, Xiongshan and the south bank by the station; their count grew as more were found.

title: When the Japanese took the town's north-west corner
basis: The regiment's own report breaches the corner at 07:50 and again at 15:30 and storms it at 19:25; the official history's 07:30 is nearest the first breaching shoot.

records.label: the 11th Company's assault

title: Who held the north-west corner on the night of 28 March
reading: The Japanese foothold kept from 19:25 on the 28th until the 31st
basis: The 11th Company stays at the corner in the Japanese reports until it is withdrawn at 20:00 on 31 March; the Chinese special company's retaking of the Wenchang pavilion, the corner's highest point, is told but not shown.
